name: neuralforge
displayName: NeuralForge AI: YOLO & Cluster MLOps Suite
description: Enterprise AI MLOps suite for distributed YOLO26/v8 training, Optuna hyperparameter optimization, real-time Celery/Kubernetes cluster monitoring, Explainable AI (Eigen-CAM heatmaps, Deletion AUC), and MLflow artifact management.

neuralforge.controlHost.description: Host IP or hostname of the NeuralForge Manager / Control Server.

neuralforge.controlPort.description: REST API port of the NeuralForge Control Server (default 23442).

neuralforge.k8sAdminPort.description: Kubernetes NodePort for the Cluster Admin API service (default 30001).

neuralforge.adminHost.description: Host IP or hostname for Cluster Admin API.

neuralforge.adminUsername.description: Username for Cluster Admin API authentication.

neuralforge.adminPassword.description: Password for Cluster Admin API authentication.

neuralforge.mlflowPort.description: Port of the MLflow Tracking Server for artifacts and experiment metrics (default 5000).

neuralforge.defaultModel.description: Default base architecture model for new configuration files.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.install:all: npm run --prefix . package && npx @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies && code --install-extension neuralforge-0.0.3.vsix --force 2>/dev/null || true && antigravity --install-extension neuralforge-0.0.3.vsix --force 2>/dev/null || true
